name: purisev
description: Plugins for coding agents, maintained by purisev.

plugins.name: openviking-memory
plugins.description: Long-term semantic memory backed by OpenViking: recall on each prompt, capture per turn, commit on session end and before compaction, plus OpenViking's MCP tools.

plugins.name: ov-wiki
plugins.description: An agent-authored Markdown wiki stored in OpenViking: init, ingest, query, lint and recover. Depends on openviking-memory for the OpenViking tools.
